data.action: 赤足盘腿坐于平整礁石上，双手轻按膝头横放大剑
data.description: 退潮时分浮出水面的平整黑礁石上，斯卡蒂赤足盘腿而坐，巨剑平稳横放在膝上，任由清凉的浅水漫过脚边。午后日光洒在平静的海面与银白长发上，她微微低眸，享受着远离喧嚣的片刻宁静。
data.lighting: 午后侧光照进潮池，水面反光延伸到黑岩和红缘黑战衣下摆
data.promptProse: From the height of the nearest tide pool, Skadi sits cross-legged and barefoot on a broad shelf of black rock exposed by the ebb tide. Her giant sword lies flat across both knees, its hilt projecting to one side and its point to the other. Her palms rest on the blade as she looks down at the water beside the shelf. The red zip and narrow edging of her sleeveless hunter suit catch the reflected sun. A dark fringe of seaweed separates the still pools from the broad inlet, where the last ripples of the tide run between low reefs.
data.title: 斯卡蒂 · 近海平礁的赤足小憩
data.animaCaption: Both of her knees support the same greatsword, laid flat across her lap as her open hands rest on it. She sits cross-legged on a broad dry shelf of black rock between sunlit tidal pools.
